admin_requests_auto_approve.name: admin_requests_auto_approve
admin_requests_auto_approve.where: status = 'pending' and auto_approve_at is not null

admin_requests_shape_v2.name: admin_requests_shape_v2
admin_requests_shape_v2.value: ("admin_requests"."kind" in ('join_admin', 'nominate_admin') and "admin_requests"."society_id" is not null) or ("admin_requests"."kind" = 'new_society' and "admin_requests"."society_name" is not null and "admin_requests"."city" is not null and "admin_requests"."address" is not null and "admin_requests"."center_lat" is not null and "admin_requests"."center_lng" is not null and "admin_requests"."radius_m" is not null and "admin_requests"."tower_name" is not null and "admin_requests"."flat_no" is not null and "admin_requests"."occupancy" in ('owner', 'tenant', 'family'))

admin_requests_id_proof.name: admin_requests_id_proof
admin_requests_id_proof.value: "admin_requests"."id_proof_key" is not null or ("admin_requests"."kind" = 'nominate_admin' and "admin_requests"."status" in ('nominated', 'declined', 'cancelled'))
